failures.invariant: no-fatal (PHP warnings) + button does what it says
failures.triage_note: Pro streams the sample CSV from inside the settings-tab render callback, after wp-admin has already sent HTML. header() fails and the CSV is echoed into the page. Handler: wp-career-board-pro/admin/class-pro-admin.php:1946 (render_csv_import_card) calls download_sample_csv() at :2078, header() calls at :2083-2085 (logged as 2085-2087 on the live tree). Present since the CSV importer rebuild (ab9cd41), not a 1.8.0 regression. Fix direction: handle wcb_csv_sample on admin_init or admin_post before output.
failures.repro: Log in as admin -> Career Board > Settings > Import tab -> click 'Download Sample CSV'.
failures.actual: No download and no Content-Disposition header. The settings page content area renders blank because the CSV text is dumped into the HTML and exit() truncates the page. debug.log gets 3x 'PHP Warning: Cannot modify header information - headers already sent' per click.

soft_findings.note: A job posted with Location = Remote but the 'Remote-friendly position' box unticked shows 'Location: Remote' next to 'Work Mode: On-site' in Job Details on the single job page.
